reference_format.note: WA/YYYY/NNNNN with a zero-padded 5-digit serial. Records also carry an 'Alternate Reference' of the form Pp/YYYY/NNNNN, but search matches the primary WA form - use that.

endpoints.note: The value of Civica.APIUrl on this site - the base every Recipe B call hangs off - and the site's PlanningApplicationRefType. NON-STANDARD PORT :4443 must be kept in every URL, including downloads; take host:port verbatim.

quirks.summary: The portal runs on port 4443 - drop it from any URL and nothing answers.
quirks.detail: Applies to the search page, the API base and every document download alike.

quirks.summary: Imperva Incapsula is present but PASSIVE: incap_ses_*/visid_incap_* cookies are set and no request was ever challenged.
quirks.detail: The full curl chain including downloads works through it. Cookie presence here is not a block and is not a reason to abandon the automated route.

quirks.summary: doc/list rows carry NO FileName - label files from DocDesc plus FileExtension.
quirks.detail: The zip route does carry the original names, in a doubled-extension form: '<DocDesc> - <orig>.pdf.PDF'.

source_notes: Full Recipe B curl chain works through PASSIVE Imperva Incapsula (incap_ses_*/visid_incap_* cookies, never challenged). NON-STANDARD PORT :4443 — keep it in every URL. API base /w2webparts/Resource/Civica/Handler.ashx/, RefType GFPlanning (both from page config, as documented). ZIPSTREAM: doc/list/zipstream -> one zip, byte-identical to per-doc downloads. doc/list rows have NO FileName — label from DocDesc/FileExtension; zip entry names carry the originals ('<DocDesc> - <orig>.pdf.PDF', doubled extensions). pagestream Content-Type 'application/PDF' (uppercase). Refs are zero-padded 5-digit serials (WA/YYYY/NNNNN); an 'Alternate Reference' Pp/YYYY/NNNNN also exists but primary form is what search matches.

verification.note: Full Recipe B chain ran end to end through the passive Incapsula layer. The whole-set zip from doc/list/zipstream was byte-identical to the per-document downloads.
